content: Mfum a isal a mankay
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: « Ŋun'naaŋ mwɛy kàkäl anà mfum a isal ande. Baar laa bàyun'füün ba naa nde afàtaam anà indiir ande.
Ŋun'naaŋ waa kun'bel, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: "Ndaa nà mɛ in'weemà ntɔn ngye? Nswɛŋ nsyääl angye, ntɔn ngye ayàfàlab anki musyääl indiir amɛ."
Mfum a isal kàsɛmà muyweer: "Mɛ in'kyer aben, ntɔn nkum amɛ kàman'lwom muler isal ande? In'bulà mulem an'ywaŋ? Mɛ ngwal yatɛy. In'sɛmà muyilɔm akà baar? Yà ndaa a nswɛn.
Aa, mɛ an'man naa mɛ ininà in'kyer ntɔn baar ban'wɛl u ndwà aba mpal bàyan'lwom kà isal amɛ."
Ungö apan, nde kàbeelà umwɛy umwɛy aŋankul a nkum ande. Nde kàtɛn a mbuur wàtàtwɛb naa: "Ngye kwɛ apà akà nkum amɛ?"
Nde kun'fuur naa: "Ngungulà nkam yà may." Nde waa kàtɛn naa: "Le un'kaan a nkul angye, bwaay pabà, kyer agyägyä, sɔn an'kwem an'tyeen."
Ungö nde waa kàtɛn a wumwɛy naa: "Atöl ngye kwe?" Nde naa: "Ngɔɔr nkam mwɛy yà mbɛŋ a imbab." Mfum a isal naa: "Mà un'kaan a nkul angye, sɔn an'kwem naan."
Abun, nkum kàkyer un'syäŋà un'be un'syääl awà ntɔn mankay ande. Iswaŋà naa baan a nsi yi ban'söön mankay kusà a atɔŋ aba akwà abà baan a pɛɛlà.
Wɛɛ mɛ alàkyään naa: Làtɛ isaam a in'naaŋ a loor myà mɛɛn mà. Abun, umpal myàsàkɔɔn mya, waa mya isàlawal kà ikal a mbul a in'tye.
Isàkal naa mbuur wà balàbal unsà indiir ikikye, nde asàkal sye wàbalàbal unsà indiir mbɔɔn. Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur wà ŋaloor unsà indiir ikikye, nde asàkal sye ŋaloor unsà indiir mbɔɔn.
Lalan, isàkal naa bɛ balàbal batɛy musyääl un'naaŋ a loor a mɛɛn mà, nà kan'kwo mukàlapà un'naaŋ a ndandaa?
Isàkal naa bɛ balàbal batɛy unsà indiir a baar asin, nà ayàlapà indiir abɛ ŋakwo?

Akà un'syääl mwɛy tɛy kan'kwo musyääl ankum bɔ̈ɔ̈l. Ya iyàmɛnà naa nde ayàkyey umwɛy, nde ayàtɔn wumwɛy, itàkal naa nde ayàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande akà umwɛy, nde ayàyiiŋ wumwɛy. Bɛ làkwe anki musyääl Nzam anà ngim u taaŋ làmwɛy la. »
Ndaa a ifà ifà a Yɛsu
Yàmɛnà naa Amfarisi bàwem ba ndaa ayi yanswà, ba bàsɛɛ Yɛsu, ntɔn ba bàkweenà ngim.
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bɛ làbà baar làfàswaŋ u mii a baar naa bɛ làbà balàbal, wɛɛ Nzam akiyöb boo a mpem abɛ. Undiir bàfàman baar naa wa wà làkoo, Nzam wa afàman wà ŋingyäy.
« Taaŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà là in'kaan a aŋangɔɔm làtsü apà Ywan. Sɛmà taaŋ alan, Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Imwol a Nzam ban'kyään, anà mbuur mbuur wà mukyer ngwal ntɔn mubilà kwo.
Du anà mɛɛn man'kwo isàdiimà, wɛɛ akà isɛrà mwɛy kyà Un'kɔɔn isàdiimà anki.
« Baal wanswà kàkaabà anà un'kyay ande, usàkàwal un'kyay asin, nde kan'tà inswem, wɛɛ baal wanswà asàwal un'kaar kàkaabà anà un'dim ande, nde kan'tà inswem.
Ŋun'naaŋ anà Lazar
« Taaŋ mwɛy kàkäl anà ŋun'naaŋ mwɛy kàfàbwaarà ubwaŋàbwaŋ ipfɛy a ntal. Ilä byanswà isal ande udyà anà utaam.
Ŋàlàmbwà mwɛy ikɔb ande Lazar kàfabɔ̈ɔ̈nà u mun a làpaŋ a ŋun'naaŋ awà, nde kàkäl anà inkyar u ndür ande.
Nde kàlàkwen mudyà mfür a mampà yàbwee u mɛsà a ŋun'naaŋ. Apan sye mbwà yàyee mulɛɛr inkyar ande.
Yàmɛnà naa ŋàlàmbwà waa ukü, akyeey a Nzam laa bun'syen ba akà Abàlam. Ŋun'naaŋ sye waa ukü, waa bun'dyee.
Kà an'lɔŋ, ŋun'naaŋ kàkäl uboo a mpay yà mbɔɔn. Mpal kàler nde u du laa kàmɛn nde ukwɛl Lazar tsütsü apà Abàlam.
Apan nde kàlaal in'kwɛŋ: "Taaràmɛ Abàlam, ngwem ngyɛb! Tɔm Lazar, nde udüma nswɛŋ a làpin ande kà an'dà, nde kan'nɔ̈ lànyaŋ a an'dà u làlem amɛ, ntɔn mɛ in'wà u mpay mbɔɔn uboo a mbaa yi."

Wɛɛ Abàlam kun'fuur naa: "Mwan amɛ, yɔbà ubwaŋ banswà kàmɛn ngye u mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye taaŋ kàkäl ngye u mɛɛn, wɛɛ Lazar kàkäl u mpay taaŋ lanswà. Mpalabà, apà, Lazar wà kà un'sak, wɛɛ ngye awà u mpay aŋasöönà.
Yumwɛy ayi: Uboo a bi anà bɛ we anà un'baan a kölàköl. Ilàtàkal naa ukwen bàkäl, bi ikwe anki musoonà wa, itàkal naa mufà akà bi muyà akà bɛ, itàkal naa mufà akà bɛ muyà akà bi."
Ŋun'naaŋ waa kàtɛn naa: "Isàkal abwɛy, mɛ amabɔɔn, taa, tɔm Lazar u ndwà a taaràmɛ,
ntɔn mɛ in'we abà atɔŋ abaal atyeen, nde ukakyään, manà ba sye bàyàlab mbwo a mpay ayi."
Abàlam naa: "Atɔŋ angye bye anà Mɔsɛ anà aŋangɔɔm, wɛy ba bawem."
Nde naa: "Ŋaa, taa Abàlam, manà mbuur kan'fà an'lɔŋ, kan'kyà akà ba, ba bàkyer ayàbuul mpem."
Abàlam waa kun'fuur naa: "Isàkal naa ba bàkwe anki muwem Mɔsɛ anà aŋangɔɔm, ba sye bàyàkwo anki muwem akà ikikye mbuur kan'fà an'lɔŋ." »
